item.title: Saturation at GitHub: the saga continues
item.description: When it comes to public incident write-ups, GitHub continues to be the gift that keeps on giving. They keep suffering collateral damage from the AI boom, as more developers using AI means more load… (1 source: sreweekly)

item.description: A Jev-driven SRE diagnosis pipeline passed 76.2% of 105 diagnoses. Explore its workflow, successful and failed traces, and interactive time and cost comparisons. (1 source: sreweekly)

item.title: Article: From Microservices to Agents: The Next Evolution of Distributed Systems
item.description: The article examines the transition from microservices to agentic AI architecture in distributed systems. Microservices allow for functional decomposition, while agentic systems focus on decision decomposition. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: EmbeddingGemma 2 Expands Beyond Text to Support Code, Images, Video, and Audio
item.description: Based on Gemma 4 and released under the Apache 2.0 license, Google's EmbeddingGemma 2 is a compact, open-weight, multimodal embedding model designed to make semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) more efficient while… (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Buildkite Adds Scoped Secrets and New Agentic CI Tools
item.description: Continuous integration provider Buildkite has introduced pipeline-scoped secrets and new Model Context Protocol tools for validating pipelines, diagnosing failed builds and repairing webhooks. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: NestJS 12: ESM Packages, Standard Schema Validation and Native Observability
item.description: NestJS version 12 has been released, transitioning core packages to ESM and adding Standard Schema validation. It updates the CLI and introduces an observability SDK. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: AWS Introduces Preview of Well-Architected Agent
item.description: AWS recently announced the preview of the Well-Architected Agent, a service that analyzes environments against Well-Architected best practices and provides prioritized recommendations across cost, security, performance, and reliability. (1 source: infoq)
